title: Arizona utility evidence for semiconductor and AI infrastructure power capacity
question: Which utility records show real power capacity for semiconductor and AI infrastructure?
why_it_matters: State-level electricity baselines are useful, but power availability for fabs, suppliers, and compute infrastructure depends on utility planning, interconnection, rates, service territory, and facility load evidence.
current_support: FTFN has EIA Arizona electricity context, ACC utility-regulation and eDocket layers, and SRP's named 2025 Integrated System Plan Actions Progress Report documenting resource, distribution, siting, and transmission actions.
candidate_records: specific ACC utility docket or order
SRP or APS customer-specific service and interconnection record
semiconductor facility load or service agreement evidence
next_action: Use ACC eDocket and utility records to identify a customer- or project-specific service, interconnection, tariff, or load record before making site-level power claims.
notes: Phase 51 added a named utility implementation report. The gap remains open at the project-service layer: system plans and aggregate megawatts do not prove a site can be connected or served.
